cover.coreProposition: Durable agent work should separate persistence from reconciliation: stored state needs external-change detection, durable object-level change identity, lifecycle reconciliation and isolated retry ownership before a live runtime can reliably rediscover and attempt progress.
cover.visualMetaphor: A preserved work capsule in a vault that only moves when a separate wake beacon detects and reactivates it
cover.semanticObject: One durable task capsule connected to a distinct wake beacon and isolated retry pulse
cover.compositionIntent: Landscape editorial cover with a strong dormant-to-awake tension, one focal object and clear depth, no literal system diagram
